description: The plot illustrates how a performance metric varies with token chunk size for four documentation resources. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with labeled ticks at 200, 400, 600, and 800 (the rightmost data point is at 1000). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with tick labels at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40). Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the blue “Tutorials” line increases from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500, reaches about 29 at 800, and ends near 28 at 1000; the red “Library Documentation” line rises from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500, peaks around 32 at 800, then drops to about 27 at 1000; the yellow “StackOverflow posts” line starts near 33 at 200, is about 30 at 500, declines to about 19 at 800, and ends near 12 at 1000; the green “Github files” line increases from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500, peaks around 33 at 800, and decreases slightly to about 30 at 1000.
caption_used: Performance of various documentation resources across increasing token chunk sizes. The line plot depicts how different resources respond to changes in the number of tokens, with the x-axis labeled 'Number of Tokens' ranging from 200 to 1000 in increments of 200, and the y-axis representing performance metrics from 10 to 40 in increments of 10. Four resources are compared: Tutorials (blue line), Library Documentation (red line), StackOverflow posts (yellow line), and Github files (green line). Tutorials exhibit a gradual increase in performance, starting at approximately 23 at 200 tokens and stabilizing around 30 at 800 tokens. Library Documentation initially rises from 28 at 200 tokens to a peak of 35 at 500 tokens before declining sharply to 20 by 1000 tokens. StackOverflow posts demonstrate a consistent decline, beginning at 32 and dropping steadily to 12 by 1000 tokens. Github files, however, show a robust upward trend, starting at 29 and reaching a peak of 35 at 800 tokens before slightly tapering off. Notably, Github files consistently outperform all other resources beyond 400 tokens, while Library Documentation initially surpasses Tutorials but is eventually overtaken as token size increases.
